scope.evidence: Scenario is one binary contract with a fixed USD payoff, matched discount frequency, and settlement-dated resolution (assumptions). Limitations exclude market pricing, multi-outcome payoffs, and probability calibration. Bounded.

source-fidelity.evidence: Opened both cited pages on 2026-11-04 (HTTP 200 each). Intro Stats 2e section 4.2 states mu = sum(x*P(x)) with the multiply-and-add NOTE box; the binary specialization p*X+(1-p)*0 is labeled as derived. Principles of Finance section 7.4 states PV = FV x 1/(1+r)^n (eq 7.32) with worked $20,000 -> $19,047.62 (n=1) and $1,000 -> $231.38 (n=30). Record math matches the combination exactly.

models.permitted_use: Use only as the discounted fair value p*X/(1+r)^n of a single binary USD payoff with matched discount frequency; not as a market price, not for multi-outcome payoffs, and not with an uncalibrated probability presented as observed.
